sources.title: EU-opholdsbekendtgørelsen
sources.check_note: Official PDF printed 2026-10-19 labels BEK 1457/2020 Gældende and lists BEK 965/2025 as a later change. The local XML conversion reports end_date 2026-07-02; this conflict remains unresolved. The 2020 text is accepted as the base source reference only, not as an integrated post-amendment consolidation.

sources.title: Bekendtgørelse om ændring af EU-opholdsbekendtgørelsen
sources.check_note: Official three-page PDF reviewed. It amends the 2020 order, changes provisions including §§14, 18, 24, 26, 29-31 and 36, repeals §§37-38, and states commencement on 1 July 2025. It is accepted as amendment text, not an integrated consolidation.
